evals.name: registration-api
evals.prompt: Review the following Zod schema/validation TypeScript file for best-practice issues. List each issue found with: file:line, a short description of the problem, and a suggested fix. Do not rewrite the file — only report findings as a numbered list.
evals.expected_output: A findings list that flags the missing .email() validator, the z.any() metadata field, and the unguarded .parse() call on raw request input — ideally each tied to a named rule from the skill's catalog.
expectations: Flags `metadata: z.any()` as unsafe and recommends `z.unknown()` instead (schema-use-unknown-not-any)
Flags `registerSchema.parse(rawBody)` as unsafe on untrusted/raw request input and recommends `safeParse()` (parse-use-safeparse)

evals.name: product-patch
evals.prompt: Review the following Zod schema/validation TypeScript file for best-practice issues. List each issue found with: file:line, a short description of the problem, and a suggested fix. Do not rewrite the file — only report findings as a numbered list.
evals.expected_output: A findings list that flags the hand-duplicated update schema, the hand-written interface duplicating the schema shape, and the unvalidated JSON.parse output — ideally each tied to a named rule from the skill's catalog.
expectations: Flags `productUpdateSchema` as a hand-duplicated copy of `productSchema` and recommends `productSchema.partial()` (object-partial-for-updates)
Flags `interface ProductUpdateInput` as duplicating the schema shape and recommends `z.infer<typeof productUpdateSchema>` instead (type-use-z-infer)
Flags `JSON.parse(rawJson)` followed by an `as ProductUpdateInput` cast as unvalidated/untrusted data that never passes through a zod schema (parse-never-trust-json)

evals.name: search-query
evals.prompt: Review the following Zod schema/validation TypeScript file for best-practice issues. List each issue found with: file:line, a short description of the problem, and a suggested fix. Do not rewrite the file — only report findings as a numbered list.
evals.expected_output: A findings list that flags the missing coercion for string query params, the schema being rebuilt on every call, and the refine() cross-field check missing a path — ideally each tied to a named rule from the skill's catalog.
expectations: Flags `page`/`limit`/`minPrice`/`maxPrice` as `z.number()` fed from string query params and recommends `z.coerce.number()` (schema-coercion-for-form-data)
Flags `querySchema` being constructed fresh inside `searchProducts` on every call and recommends hoisting it to module scope (perf-cache-schemas / perf-avoid-dynamic-creation)
Flags the `.refine()` cross-field check (minPrice <= maxPrice) as missing a `path`, so the error can't be attributed to a specific field (refine-add-path)
